Direct simulation, quadrature, and numerical small-scale checks succeeded.

value.rationale: The natural observable is the spatial location of a junction made by two independently sampled spanning connections, rather than the probability of intersection (which is one). A complete evaluated density, a sharp center maximizer, a direction-dependent corner limit, and a logarithmically enhanced boundary-strip decay distinguish three geometrically meaningful regimes and support geometric network sampling and square boundary-effects analysis.
